global_component_excluded_from_page264_w.floating_contact_dock: Visual blank/clipped target defect is reproducible while AX links exist, but owner is global ID7/header-dock runtime. Do not deploy a global fix from the page264 package. A page264 override requires fresh proof that the losing declaration can be corrected strictly under body.page-id-264 without altering the global owner.

formal_visual_capture_policy.browser: Same engine/DPR/zoom/load/font/image/scroll/motion state for source and target.
formal_visual_capture_policy.memory: At most one source and one target tab; reuse both, no replacement fan-out.
formal_visual_capture_policy.moving_components: Synchronize state or exclude moving regions from static diff; random carousel/review frames are not parity failures.

write_policy: Do not touch PASS content/semantics/media merely to obtain screenshot proof.
Only v006 and v007 are currently reproduced page264-local visual failures with prepared fixes.
Hero remains diagnostic-only until ownership is measured.
Interaction-proof gaps do not authorize duplicate JS/runtime owners.
PIXEL_PASS remains false until the deterministic matrix is completed.
